article_lion_and_mouse.summary: A lion catches a small mouse, and the mouse promises to help him one day. Follow the lion and the mouse from the sunny grass to the hunter's net, where the smallest friend does the biggest job. After reading, you can retell the story, use its new words, and tell its lesson.
article_lion_and_mouse.title: The Lion and the Clever Mouse

article_magical_castle.summary: Hà finds a castle that only appears to children who come with empty hands, and she spends one whole day inside it. Follow her through the kitchen, the library and the garden, and to the great door with the small slot. After reading, you can retell the day, use five new castle words in your own sentences, and explain what the castle gave back.
article_magical_castle.title: One Day in a Magical Castle

article_small_talk.summary: Small talk is a skill with rules: how to open, how to keep a stranger talking, how to read the signs that it is working, and how to leave without an awkward goodbye. After reading this you can start a conversation with anyone in a queue, an office or a lift, and keep it going for five minutes without freezing.
article_small_talk.title: The Art of Small Talk: Talking to Strangers Naturally
